summary: Trinity County lookout: a 1935 cabin on a 20-ft timber tower in Shasta-Trinity NF, staffed in the 1930s-40s, still standing but dilapidated and not safe to climb.

facts.design: California Region 5 Plan BC-301 cabin on a 20 ft open timber tower
facts.status_note: Abandoned and in poor condition; a May 2025 hike report describes the platform as sitting around the bottom of its struts, not the top.

access.note: On National Forest land, reached on foot. Sources describe the tower as not very safe to climb; do not go up it.

visit.trail_note: Hike in on trails in the Yolla Bolly-Middle Eel Wilderness; the 2025 hike began near the West Low Gap Trailhead

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Shasta-Trinity National Forest

events.note: G. H. McCausland stationed at the lookout for the summer; station closed for the season that October
Leon D. Duey succeeded the previous lookout
Built for the Trinity National Forest; California Region 5 Plan BC-301 cabin on a 20 ft open timber tower
Lookout logged 25 visitors between June 22 and October 20, 1936; 14 were Forest Service employees
Ora Snyder had been lookout for the past two years; assigned to a clerk-typist post in June 1946
Register describes the structure in poor condition but still standing as of 2017
Registered April 24, 2020 as US 1419, CA 161; nominated by Brad Eells
May 2025 hike report found the lookout dilapidated; platform sitting around the bottom of the struts; writer did not climb

notes_for_editor: Status is standing per the 2017 register text and the May 2025 hike report, which describes it as dilapidated and not safe to climb. No source found a fire at the lookout. Last staffing year not found; newspaper items run to 1946. Elevation differs across sources (7,765 / 7,769 / 7,792 ft); register figure matches the record. The 1933 newspaper item also reports a personal arrest of the previous lookout; left out of the story. Built year 1935 comes from the register alone; no construction record found. Access is hike-only in wilderness; no current closure notice found. Do not encourage climbing.
